name: newsdesk
description: Landing page for NewsDesk, a private macOS news reader that gathers RSS, Google News, Reddit and Hacker News headlines and groups the same story from many outlets. Static Dutch/English HTML + CSS site, no JavaScript or build step, newspaper design with dark mode, on Netlify. App code itself is not included.

paragraphs: NewsDesk is a private news reader built by VolNix. It collects headlines from RSS feeds, Google News, Reddit and Hacker News across six categories (tech, crypto, finance, sport, entertainment and politics). It then clusters differently worded headlines about the same story, so one story shows every outlet reporting it. It runs as a native macOS SwiftUI app with an in-app reader, alongside a browser dashboard, and includes a studio for drafting copy-ready posts per story.
